rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Rotate SOL->BTC on a risk-OFF tape where downside protection wins. The crypto complex is turning defensive: total market cap -1.3% to ~$2.3T, Fear & Greed dropped to 28 (fear), BTC -1.4% (~$64,961) and ETH soft (~$1,625). BTC is holding the $64,000 floor of a well-defined $64,000-$66,800 range after a ~13% recovery off July's lows, giving the cleanest definable-stop setup in the liquid universe. No fresh idiosyncratic BTC catalyst, but the setup is a base-holding major into event risk rather than a momentum chase.
positions.driver: Rolled SOL out at 76.11 for a -$264.94 loss (range-bound alt gave back its shelf) and rotated to the protective major. On a low-edge, fear-driven day the mandate favors the liquid majors with the tightest downside, not the highest-beta alt. BTC wins vs runners-up: SOL (~76.11) and ETH (~1,874) both carry the fresher catalyst (Morgan Stanley's 0.14% ultra-low-fee ETH/SOL ETFs, continued BSOL inflows, Solana on-chain analytics) but are higher-beta and fall hardest if risk-off deepens into the 7/28-29 FOMC. BTC's range floor + 8% stop give the best risk-adjusted 24h payoff when protection is the priority.
positions.risks: Key risk is a hawkish FOMC (7/28-29) with a non-trivial rate-HIKE probability priced in; a risk-off break of the $64,000 range floor invalidates the base-holding thesis and BTC could slide toward the low-$60Ks. Fear & Greed at 28 signals fragile sentiment. Hard stop 59316.58 (-8%, majors rule) sits below the range floor to avoid noise while capping downside.
